review.markdown:
# Review

The slice points in the right direction: candidate snapshot admission is bounded, image build is designed to avoid candidate Dockerfile/RUN/hooks and network, containment flags are strong, stop evidence is separated from business exit classification, and the broker already has fence/beforeEffect/unknown-retention seams. I would not require full G25 recovery first. However the supplied seams do not yet bind or settle a contained tests action as proposed.

Blocking gaps: the contained executor overrides image WORKDIR to /tmp and its spec digest omits candidate dir/receipt/daemon/invocation; the broker has no contained registration kind and still models command execution as host POSIX runShellCommand; verification evidence schema requires POSIX process-group termination and cannot carry image/container/invocation/generation binding; abort handling can discard an already-observed business exit. These are design/seam mismatches, not reasons to recover all G25.

judgments.summary: Candidate/image/ledger linkage is described, but current executor spec binds only image+command+opaque bindingRef, forces WorkingDir /tmp instead of the receipt candidate dir, and the broker/evidence schema lack a contained kind carrying invocation, generation, container ID, image receipt and stop receipt without trusting worker/model identity.

Image preparation constraints are sound, but execution contradicts them: container config sets/enforces WorkingDir /tmp with tmpfs, so candidate files copied to a reserved image directory are not the execution context unless the command independently knows an unbound path; no contained broker registration seam is present to preserve this through G04.

Stop removal evidence is separate and fail exit-code sets are disjoint, but tests evidence validation requires POSIX termination fields, rejects non-pass/fail outcomes before passed=false can be persisted, and abort-before-exit ordering can convert an observed business failure into cancelled exitCode 1.

findings.message: Contained executor config and inspect enforcement hardcode WorkingDir '/tmp' while the proposal requires Config.WorkingDir to equal the image receipt candidate directory and spec digest to bind it.
findings.evidence: config(): WorkingDir '/tmp', Tmpfs {'/tmp': ...}; inspect expects v.Config.WorkingDir === '/tmp'; specDigest hashes only image/command/binding/policy.

findings.message: GraphActionBroker RegisteredExecution has only freeze/workspace/adapter/command kinds; command execution is runShellCommand in the host workspace, not a contained Docker invocation allocated with invocation ID and beforeEffect.
findings.evidence: RegisteredExecution union lacks 'contained'; command path calls runShellCommand(... cwd: action.workspace.workspace_path ...).

findings.message: Tests envelope validation requires command.termination.scope 'posix_process_group', trigger 'exit', leader_exit_code equality and stop_confirmed, leaving no valid representation for the proposed separate contained result with stopReceipt digest/image binding/container ID.
findings.evidence: tests branch rejects unless command.termination.scope === 'posix_process_group' and trigger === 'exit'.

findings.message: GraphVerificationEnvelope validates binding/effect/acceptance/candidate identity, but has no fields to persist and later compare contained invocation ID, actual container ID, image receipt digest, daemon ID, generation/effectKey/invocation linkage or stop receipt digest.
findings.evidence: validateEnvelope checks candidateIdentity before/after and command evidence, but not contained launch/receipt identity.

findings.message: In execute(), the polling loop checks signal.aborted before observing an exited state; on abort the catch returns cancelled with exitCode 1 after stop, which can erase a valid business fail exit code observed racing with cancellation.
findings.evidence: for (;;) { if (signal.aborted) throw CONTAINED_CANCELLED; ... if (!state.Running && state.Status === 'exited') ... } catch { ... if (signal.aborted) return { exitCode: 1, cancelled: true } }

findings.message: Acceptance allows exit codes outside pass/fail sets, but tests evidence without verificationFailure throws unless exitCode is in pass or fail, so an ambiguous stopped exit cannot remain admitted/unknown as an explicit settlement outcome.
findings.evidence: parseAcceptanceCommand permits disjoint sets; validateEnvelope tests requires exitCode in [...passExitCodes, ...failExitCodes] when no verificationFailure.

recommended_actions: Add a contained RegisteredExecution kind whose factory receives scope/run/generation/effectKey/invocationId and whose beforeEffect marks the actual ledger running before create/start.

Make the image receipt candidate directory an explicit executor input; set and verify Config.WorkingDir to that exact receipt path and include candidate dir, image receipt, daemon ID, acceptance digest, invocation/generation/effectKey in the spec/binding digest.

Extend tests evidence schema with a contained command result variant carrying actual exitCode/cancelled, stopReceipt digest, image/container/daemon/invocation binding; do not require or forge POSIX process-group fields for contained execution.

Define settlement ordering so an exited state already observed is settled as pass/fail, while unobserved exit after cancel/timeout remains unknown and retains admission; persist ambiguous exit codes as unknown rather than rejecting or forcing passed=false.

Add focused negative tests for symlink/path admission, OnBuild/Volumes/base drift, WORKDIR override, receipt mismatch, stale generation/fence at start/stop/read, fail exit codes, ambiguous exit codes, abort races and Docker delete-ACK loss.

Image preparation constraints are sound, but execution contradicts them: container config sets/enforces WorkingDir /tmp with tmpfs, so candidate files copied to a reserved image directory are not the execution context unless the command independently knows an unbound path; no contained broker registration seam is present to preserve this through G04.
